visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a low-angle handheld shot of a Costco Wholesale exterior in Australia. The red and blue brand logo is prominently displayed on a grey corrugated metal wall. The lighting is natural and bright, suggesting a clear, sunny day outside. (2) A sequence of close-ups reveals the indoor menu boards. Large posters display pizza slices, chicken burgers, Aussie steak pies, and hot dogs with prices. The indoor lighting is bright studio-style, and the camera pans across the various food options available at the counter. (3) The camera captures the food preparation area, showing rows of meat pies and a whole cheese pizza under warm heating lamps. A person's hand is seen interacting with a digital ordering kiosk, pointing at the screen to select specific items for purchase. (4) A young man with glasses and a green jacket is shown in a medium shot eating a chicken burger. He holds the burger with both hands and takes a bite, then displays the cross-section of the fried chicken and lettuce to the camera. (5) The man is seen eating a long hot dog from a paper wrapper. He holds the hot dog close to the camera, showing the ketchup and mustard toppings. The background shows a brightly lit indoor seating area with other patrons blurred in the distance. (6) A close-up shot focuses on a clear plastic cup filled with a dark-colored bubble tea slushie. The man uses a straw to stir the ice and shows a single dark pearl on his hand, demonstrating its texture and size to the viewers. (7) The man bites into a savory meat pie, revealing a thick brown gravy and beef chunks inside. He uses a wooden spoon to scoop the filling, showing the flaky pastry crust. The background remains a consistent indoor dining environment. (8) Returning to the digital kiosk, more items are selected, including pizza slices and desserts. The screen shows images of sundaes and a large chocolate chip cookie. The camera framing is tight on the interface for clarity of the menu items. (9) Large slices of pepperoni and cheese pizza are shown on white paper plates. A woman is seen taking a large bite of a pizza slice. The man then eats his own slice, showing the melted cheese and greasy toppings in a close-up. (10) A Costco staff member wearing a red hat and white gloves prepares a chocolate sundae, squeezing soft-serve into a cup and drizzling it with syrup. The man is then shown eating a cookie, expressing his reaction to its sweetness. (11) A physical receipt from Costco Wholesale Australia is shown, listing the items and prices in Australian dollars. The video concludes with shots of the menu boards and the staff working behind the counter, followed by the brand logo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male narrator begins speaking with a clear, professional tone over an upbeat, electronic pop background music track. The BGM remains consistent in volume and rhythm underneath the narration. (3) The sound of a plastic lid snapping onto a drink cup is audible as the narrator discusses the hot dog and soda combo. The narrator's voice remains dominant in the mix, exhibiting high articulation clarity and a friendly, casual tone throughout the description. (4) A distinct rustle of paper and food wrappers occurs as the narrator prepares to taste the chicken burger. He notes the buttery aroma of the bun while the background music continues with a strong, rhythmic beat that maintains a consistent pace. (5) A clear slurping sound through a straw is heard as the narrator tries the bubble tea slushie. His voice describes the icy texture and the chewy quality of the pearls, maintaining a positive valence and high arousal level in his speech. He emphasizes the beef chunks inside, with his vocal intensity remaining moderate and his tone becoming more descriptive and informative. (7) A second digital UI click sound effect marks the start of the next phase of the food review. The narrator's speech density remains high as he lists the prices of the pizza slices, sundaes, and cookies in the second round of ordering. (8) The percussive sound of a rolling cutter slicing through a pizza crust is heard. The narrator expresses his preference for the pepperoni slice, with the background music's synthesizer melodies providing a constant harmonic bed for his vocal delivery. (9) A mechanical hum from a soft-serve ice cream machine is heard, followed by the subtle sound of thick chocolate sauce being poured onto a sundae. The narrator comments on the generous portion size with an excited and animated vocal quality. (10) A crisp, percussive crunching sound is captured as the narrator bites into a chocolate chip cookie. He describes the warmth and high sugar content of the cookie, with his voice showing high dominance and a humorous, teasing tone. (11) The narrator concludes the video by mentioning the total cost of the meal. The background music maintains its tempo until a final hard cut ends the audio track, while the narrator's closing question to the audience is delivered clearly.
